newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Fischler sketches EU farm reform timetable.
newsitem.headline: Fischler sketches EU farm reform timetable.

text.p: Detailed proposals for the reform of cereals, beef and other sectors will be presented after the EU summit in Luxembourg in December, EU Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler said.
EU farm ministers would finalise on November 18-19 their general position on agricultural reform for approval by the EU summit.
Speaking after a meeting of EU farm ministers, Fischler said proposals for tobacco and olive oil reforms would be presented after the European Parliament had given its opinion.
Regarding wine, Fischler said he was waiting for the result of this year's harvest and would then put forward a new reform proposal early next year.

During a private dinner discussion on the Commission's Agenda 2000 programme to prepare for enlargement eastwards, ministers from northern member states complained that the reforms targeted cereals and other northern crops.
But southern farm ministers complained that wine and other Mediterranean products were being neglected and not receiving a fair share of EU farm subsidies.
